key_insight: Evidence-grounded language models guided perovskite contact design, selecting a K analogue that outperformed the Na analogue preferred by experts.
engineering_relevance: Devices using the AI-selected contact achieved 27.05% power conversion efficiency and retained 96.74% of initial efficiency after 1,000 hours of dark thermal ageing at 85 °C.
method: Reconstruct expert-calibrated evidence records from 4,035 training articles.
Train OpenPerov to connect experimental strategies, controls and observations with mechanistic interpretations.
Refine selected responses with retrieved evidence in OpenPerov Pro.
evidence_signal: On the 800-question PSM-Bench, OpenPerov Flash ranked first among 13 closed-book systems; retrieval-assisted Pro increased Scientific Mastery from 87.6 to 89.1.
watch_item: The reported experimental demonstration concerns one contact-design comparison; broader design reliability and operational stability under illumination require further validation.
paper_title: Evidence-grounded large language models guide perovskite solar cell design and optimization
